caption: The drawing consists of several objects and design elements rendered in shades of gray and yellowish-brown. The central object is a detailed, golden-colored andiron or fireplace tool stand, with a tall, ornate spindle topped by a finial. Its base comprises three curved legs ending in claw-like feet, supporting a cubic segment decorated with floral engravings. Adjacent to the main object, on the right side, there is a vertically oriented floral decorative motif drawn in thin lines. Towards the bottom left, there is a square inset featuring a stylized flower with three leaves and smaller surrounding motifs, all rendered in a dotted outline. In the upper left quadrant, there is a technical line drawing of the central object, including a scale in inches for measurements, and stylized scrollwork at the feet. The artist’s name, "HANS KORSCH," is written in capital letters in the bottom right corner. The entire composition is neatly contained within a double-lined rectangular border.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
